description: This Java source file defines the 'GestureBuilderActivity' class, which is an Android activity responsible for managing, displaying, and editing gesture sets within the gesture building portion of an Android application. It includes methods for loading gestures, renaming, deleting, and adding gestures, and handles various user interactions and background tasks related to gesture management.

classes.name: NamedGesture
classes.description: A simple data class that holds a gesture's name and the actual Gesture object.

classes.name: GesturesAdapter
classes.description: An ArrayAdapter subclass that manages the display of gesture items including their thumbnails and labels in the list.

classes.name: GesturesLoadTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass that loads gestures from storage, generates thumbnails, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and begins loading gestures.

methods.name: reloadGestures
methods.description: Reloads the gestures loaded from storage.

methods.name: addGesture
methods.description: Starts the activity to create a new gesture.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from activities started for result, such as adding a new gesture.

methods.name: loadGestures
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous task to load gestures from storage.

methods.name: checkForEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the gesture list is empty and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves state information, such as gesture IDs, for instance restoration.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores saved state, including the gesture being renamed if applicable.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates context menu items for gesture entries (rename, delete).

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles interactions with context menu items.

methods.name: renameGesture
methods.description: Initiates the renaming process for a given gesture.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs, such as rename confirmation dialog.

methods.name: onPrepareDialog
methods.description: Prepares dialogs before display, such as setting the current gesture name in rename dialog.

methods.name: createRenameDialog
methods.description: Constructs the dialog interface for renaming a gesture.

methods.name: changeGestureName
methods.description: Handles the logic for changing a gesture's name after user input.

methods.name: cleanupRenameDialog
methods.description: Dismantles the rename dialog and resets related references.

methods.name: deleteGesture
methods.description: Removes a gesture from storage and updates the UI.
